text.description_html:
AHI SIG136, Stainless Steel Sierra Door Lever

AHI's Sierra Door Lever is reminiscent of 1930's shapes. Going with the saying: what is old is new again, the redolent shape of the door lever is a great way to add a little retro flair to your home but in a very contemporary way. This modern lever is made from stainless steel and is a part of AHI Hardware's Sigma Series. It fits any standard 2-1/8 inch bore hole door preparation. Available in either satin stainless steel or polished stainless steel finishes, this lever and rose set can be adjusted for 1-3/8 inch to 2 inch thick doors with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. The Sierra Lever is ADA compliant and is suitable for both residential and commercial applications. Available in dummy, passage, and privacy functions.

Features of the AHI SIG136 Stainless Steel Sierra Leverset:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Good for both residential and commercial applications.
  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Field reversible tubular latch.
  • Meets the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

Specifications of the SIG136 Stainless Steel Sierra Lever:

  • Lever Length: 5.39" (137 mm)
  • Lever Projection: 2.20" (56 mm)
  • Spindle Width: 0.31" (8 mm)
  • Rose Diameter: 2.52" (64 mm)
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" to 2"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a door pull or to match trim. Trim is on one side of door. Lever is surface mounted (mounting plate screws to the doors face).
  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door levers on both sides of the door. For use with a standard 2-1/8" bore hole pre-drilled door.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy push button and retract the door latch.

Note: Single Dummy is Handed. All other functions are non-handed. Handing Guide
